description:
Returns aggregated metric values as a yearly or monthly timeseries for a location.
When to use: Detect long-term trends and compute statistical significance (r-squared, p-value). Best suited for multi-decade spans.
Date format: mm_dd_start/mm_dd_end as MMDD (day-of-year window, not a calendar year); year_start/year_end as YYYY. Note: Use mm_dd_start/mm_dd_end as MM when months are specified and MMDD when week-level granularity is needed. When day-level info is needed use /events or /dailycomp.
Performance: Computed on demand; slower for large date ranges or many metrics.
Prerequisites: Use /location to obtain a locid first.
Investigate: Use for trend analysis ('Is max temperature at location X increasing over decades?'). Combine with r-squared post-processing for significance.
Augment: Provides decadal trend context alongside current anomalies ('temperatures have risen 1.5°C over 40 years'). Returns: locid, lat, lon, xvals, yvals.

groupby.description: Aggregating key: Year | Month | Week | Hour (default: Year)

metrics.description:
Comma separated list of tuple describing aggregation function:metric_id.attribute
ex: sum:obs.is_rain.count, avg:max_t.p99
agg_func = {sum,avg,min,max}. See /api/metrics for metric and attribtutes

name.description: Common name of metro or metro area. for ex: New York, Beijing, Mumbai Airport

src_type.description: Data source type: Obs (station observations) | ERA5 (reanalysis gridded data) (default: Obs)

name: timeseries
title: Historical Time Series
